g.text: Inherited developmental differences form sustained chemical patterns
Three independent histories · Four nested mechanical contexts · 16 cells per context
Dotted: primary threshold 0.1. Shaded: late persistence window (elapsed 36–60).
Finer clock dt = 0.001875; physical t = 18–78. Chemical contrast is not a biological identity label.
